lines.zh: 摆着尾巴，在浅水里打转。
lines.en: Tail swishing, I circle in the shallows.

lines.zh: 鳃边冒泡，我贴着泥底游。
lines.en: Bubbles at my gills as I skim the mud.

lines.zh: 小尾巴一甩，游进睡莲根间。
lines.en: One flick of my tail takes me among lily roots.

lines.zh: 卵壳刚破，我就开始游了。
lines.en: The shell just split and I am already swimming.
The water is murky, perfect for hiding.

lines.zh: 我长得太快，皮肤一天一换。
lines.en: I grow so fast my skin changes daily.

lines.zh: 池塘太浅，我去找更深的水。
lines.en: This pond is too shallow; I seek deeper water.

lines.zh: 吞下一串水藻，我又胖一圈。
lines.en: I swallow a strand of algae and grow rounder.

lines.zh: 后腿刚冒头，还蹬不动水。
lines.en: My hind legs just sprouted and barely kick.

lines.zh: 别踩，我就在这片水草下。
lines.en: Don't step there; I am under these weeds.
Wait to become a big frog!
Do not disturb, my legs are still growing.

lines.zh: 趴在泥里，只露两只眼睛。
lines.en: I lie in the mud with just my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 尾巴慢慢摆，等小虫靠近。
lines.en: My tail sways slowly, waiting for bugs.
I am small. Do not scoop me with a net.
One tail flick muddies the water.

lines.zh: 我尾鳍还没长全，别打我。
lines.en: My tail fin is not grown yet, do not hit me.

lines.zh: 我这条蝌蚪，快撑不住水了。
lines.en: This tadpole is barely holding in the water.

lines.zh: 鼓翼飞舞，蛙鸣引诱猎物。
lines.en: Flap wings, call out to prey.
Tail sways, draws in small insects.

lines.zh: 皮肤湿润，粘住飞行昆虫。
蛙鸣回荡，猎物无法抗拒。

lines.en: Leap to catch, call like thunder.

lines.zh: 翅膀闪烁，蛙鸣诱惑猎物。
湿润皮肤，吸引飞行猎物。
蛙鸣震耳，小虫难以逃逸。
lines.en: Call deafens, small insects can't escape.

lines.zh: 蛙鸣引诱，小虫飞来送死。
lines.en: Call lures in, bugs fly to die.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍打，蛙鸣召唤猎物。
撞上岩浆，瞬间灰飞烟灭。
撞击石块，肉眼可见溅血。
撞倒敌人，弹起继续前行。
撞上树木，叶子四散飞舞。
撞入草丛，绿叶间消失不见。
撞倒花丛，花瓣洒落一地。
撞上岩壁，身体贴壁而行。
撞击地面，尘土飞扬四散。
撞上敌人，使其倒地昏迷。
撞入水池，激起水花四溅。
互相触碰，释放求偶信号。
蛙鸣共鸣，求偶舞蹈开始。
蛙鸣配合，求偶行为上演。
彼此靠近，求偶舞蹈进行。
蛙鸣交织，求偶激情爆发。
互相缠绕，求偶进入高潮。
蛙鸣停止，求偶仪式结束。
咕噜咕噜，这小家伙真滑腻！
lines.en: Gloop gloop, this little one is slippery!
Sss, I need to hold on to you!
Hey, don’t move! I’ll take you for a ride!
This little one is quite heavy!
Hey, hold on tight! I’m flying!
Hang on tight, don’t let me drop!
Sss, hold on, I’m flying now!

lines.zh: 我还没长腿，只能用尾巴撞你。
lines.en: No legs yet; I can only bump you with my tail.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一摆，水里全是泥。
lines.en: One flick of my tail muddies the water.
Gloop gloop, I’m going to eat you!
Sss, be careful of my big tongue!
Gloop gloop, you can’t run away!
Blowing bubbles, I burrow into the waterweed.

lines.zh: 我摆着尾巴，往深水那边带路。
lines.en: Wagging my tail, I lead the way to deeper water.
Sss, I’ll take you to play!
Gloop gloop, learn to swim with me!
Croak, here I come to eat you!

lines.zh: 快闪开，我的舌头要来了！
吞了你，变成我的一部分！
lines.en: Swallow you, become part of me!

lines.zh: 呱呱，我的舌头能吃掉你！
lines.en: Croak, my tongue can eat you!
Bit you, enjoy my big jaws!

lines.zh: 从泥巴中醒来，我要长大！

lines.en: Poke out of water, I'll grow!

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，我要成为巨蛙！
lines.en: Rumble, I'll be a giant frog!
Crawl out of mud, I'm grown!
Croak, I'll be a giant frog soon!

lines.zh: 一枚卵裂开，我钻了出来。
lines.en: An egg splits and out I come.

lines.zh: 培育器里，我第一次摆尾。
lines.en: In the incubator I swish my tail for the first time.

lines.zh: 浅水里多了一只小蝌蚪。
lines.en: One more tadpole in the shallows.
At the muddy pond I break free of the membrane.

lines.zh: 水被烧热了，我的皮在发烫。
lines.en: The water heats up, and my skin burns.

lines.zh: 水灌进鳃里，我浮不上去。
lines.en: Water floods my gills; I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 我还没长出腿，就被炸散了。
lines.en: I had not grown legs before the blast took me apart.
The arrow went through my tail.

lines.zh: 水面一亮，我整条尾巴都麻了。
lines.en: The water flashes, and my whole tail goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的尾巴没用。
lines.en: No water in the void, my tail is useless.
